selection: minimum clean stage validation NLL with min_delta
initialization: ImageNet-1K V1, never a previous study checkpoint

metric_definitions.train_loss: Unweighted unsmoothed NLL: all training images, clean transform, model.eval(), fixed end-epoch weights
metric_definitions.val_loss: Unweighted unsmoothed NLL: all validation images, same clean transform and model.eval(), same end-epoch weights
metric_definitions.train_online_nll: Unweighted unsmoothed NLL during optimization: augmented images, dropout/BatchNorm train mode, evolving weights
metric_definitions.train_stage_objective: Per-draw mean of group/class-weighted label-smoothed stage cross entropy used for backpropagation
metric_definitions.train_total_objective_per_step: Mean of actual stage-plus-scheduled-auxiliary scalar objectives across optimizer steps; excludes decoupled AdamW decay
metric_definitions.train_aux_online_nll: Unsmoothed NLL on class-balanced sampled augmented clinical slices in train mode
metric_definitions.train_aux_objective: Per-sampled-slice mean of smoothed auxiliary cross entropy before aux_weight
metric_definitions.train_aux_eval_nll: Clean fixed-checkpoint NLL after averaging slice probabilities per training subject
metric_definitions.val_aux_nll: Clean fixed-checkpoint NLL after averaging slice probabilities per validation subject
